description: Internet Infrastructure Data Base (IIDB) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Juliao Braga. This data is a set of three data bases, named Internet Infrastructure Data Base (IIDB). The IIDB is composed of iidb.rfc, iidb.person, and iidb.acronym. The data contained in iidb.rfc and iidb.person were created after processing the contents available at the RFC Index web page. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
